title: rag-grounded-gate answer.json
description: Contract for the answer.json input consumed by rag-grounded-gate check. It is not run by the tool, and it is not byte-equivalent to check_schema(): the schema is stricter on retrieved_chunks_count (minimum 0) and generated_utc (pattern), which the gate enforces later as exit 1 rather than at schema time, and looser on chunk_id, whose pattern admits '..' while the gate rejects it with exit 2. Validate against both.

span.description: Must also contain at least 3 whitespace-delimited words; short spans are rejected as too weak to serve as a faithfulness citation.

chunk_id.description: Restricted to a safe filename character set. The pattern above excludes '/' and '\' but does NOT exclude '..'; the gate applies that additional rejection itself (exit 2, 'chunk_id: invalid path segment'). The gate resolves this against chunks_dir as <chunk_id>.txt and <chunk_id>.meta.json.

retrieved_chunks_count.description: Self-reported by the caller. The gate cross-checks it against whether chunks_dir contains any .txt files, but does not verify the exact count.
